statement.zh: 在平衡、只有活跃者给予、活动需要支持之下，没有被支持者向一个条件给予时（供给者都不被支持时就是这样），从它取用的形成至多连续活跃该条件水平那么多步；保住自身支持的形成，仍可经其供给者终结。
statement.en: Under balance, with only active formations giving and activity needing support, a formation taking from a condition fed by nothing supported, as where feeders are unsupported, stays active at most as many consecutive steps as that level; keeping its own support, it can still end through its feeder.

laws.zh: 设流平衡，只有活跃者给予，活动需要支持。若形成 g 从第 T 步起在其活跃的每一步都在场并从条件 c 取用，而在这些步没有被支持者向 c 给予，则 g 从第 T 步起至多连续活跃 c 在第 T 步的水平那么多步（由 Flow.excess_bounded 推出），所以并非从第 T 步起每步都活跃。
laws.en: Let the flow balance, with only active formations giving and activity needing support. If a formation g is present and takes from a condition c at every step from T at which it is active, while nothing supported gives to c at those steps, then g is active for at most as many consecutive steps from T as the level of c at T (derived from Flow.excess_bounded), so it is not active at every step from T.

laws.zh: 若 g 活跃时需要 c，而从第 T 步起供给其延续的都不被支持，则没有被支持者向 c 给予，所以同一界成立。
laws.en: If g requires c while active and everything feeding its continuation from T on is unsupported, nothing supported gives to c, so the same bound holds.

laws.zh: 两个界在任一世界中成立，局部条件写在规律之内：只在所计的连续各步上要求 c 处平衡、向 c 给予者都被支持；平衡、只有活跃者给予与活动需要支持处处成立时的形式是它们的推论。
laws.en: Both bounds hold in every world with the local condition inside the law: balance at c, and whatever gives to c supported, only across the consecutive steps counted; the forms with balance, only active formations giving and activity needing support everywhere are their corollaries.

laws.zh: 见证 Overshoot：两个形成各自以所需一依存于以自身命名的条件，两个条件起初都立于一；第 0 步 true 从两个条件各取一个单位并向 false 的条件给予一个，false 从自己的条件取一个并向 true 的条件给予一个，所以任一个的供给闭包都是整体。
laws.en: The witness Overshoot: each of two formations depends at need one on the condition named by it, both conditions standing at one at the start; at step 0 true takes one unit from each condition and gives one to false's, and false takes one from its own and gives one to true's, so the feeding closure of either is the whole.

laws.zh: 其中流平衡，只有活跃者给予，只有活跃者取用、且只从其所汲取者取用，活动需要支持；第 0 步 true 在其所需的唯一条件上更新，在第 1 步仍被支持，而它的汲取侵蚀 false 的依存，false 在第 0 步供给 true 的条件。
laws.en: There the flow balances, only active formations give, only active formations take and only from what they draw on, and activity needs support; at step 0 true renews over the one condition it requires and is still supported at step 1, while its draw undermines false's dependence, and false feeds true's condition at step 0.

laws.zh: Overshoot 中 false 从第 1 步起不被支持，true 从第 1 步起至多连续活跃一步，从第 2 步起没有任何被支持者。
laws.en: In Overshoot false is unsupported from step 1 on, true is active for at most one consecutive step from step 1, and from step 2 on nothing is supported.

laws.zh: 依存相同而各自只从自己的条件取用时，流平衡，两者每步都活跃且被支持。
laws.en: With the same dependences, each taking only from its own condition, the flow balances and both are active and supported at every step.

laws.zh: 局部平衡下需求满足的精确条件：一步后满足 m 恰当 m+所取不超过原水平+所给，并有逐步与整段形式。
laws.en: Exact conditions for meeting needs under local balance: meeting m after a step is equivalent to m+taken not exceeding level+given, with every-step and stretch forms.

laws.zh: 给予者被支持且没有被支持者给予时，段末满足需要恰当初始存量覆盖累计取用与需要；需要并取用的步数超过初始水平时，某一步存在被支持的供给者。
laws.en: When givers are supported and none supported gives, meeting a need at the stretch’s end is equivalent to the initial stock covering cumulative taking plus need; requiring and taking for more steps than the initial level exhibits a supported feeder at one of them.

laws.zh: 扣留在该条件只给不取的部分、其余交换固定时，满足需要恰当实际水平覆盖需要与该部分此前累计给予。
laws.en: Withholding a part taking nothing from the condition while fixing the remaining exchange preserves the need exactly where the actual level covers the need plus that part’s cumulative giving.

laws.zh: Redundant 中任一供给者足够；两者都没有的参照流在已有界内停止活动。同一个实际流扣留任一个仍有容许消费者的水平路径；两者都扣留而其余取用固定时没有平衡路径。
laws.en: Either feeder suffices in Redundant; the reference flow with neither ends activity within the existing bound. Withholding either from the actual flow leaves an admitted level path; withholding both with remaining taking fixed leaves no balancing path.

hypotheses.zh: 平衡（Flow.Balances）、只有活跃者给予（Flow.Acting）、活动需要支持（Web.Dependent）；g 在其活跃的每一步在场并从 c 取用；没有被支持者向 c 给予，或 g 活跃时需要 c 而供给其延续的都不被支持。
hypotheses.en: Balance (Flow.Balances), only active formations giving (Flow.Acting) and activity needing support (Web.Dependent); g present and taking from c at every step at which it is active; nothing supported giving to c, or g requiring c while active with everything feeding its continuation unsupported.

hypotheses.zh: 见证另有只有活跃者取用、且只从其所汲取者取用（Flow.Taking）。
hypotheses.en: The witnesses also have only active formations taking, and only from what they draw on (Flow.Taking).

hypotheses.zh: Overshoot 与 steady 是两个流：以扣留水平作的比较固定交换的其余部分，所以经动力学返回的终结在实际的流上、对照另一个参照流来表明。
hypotheses.en: Overshoot and steady are two flows: comparisons by withheld levels keep the rest of the exchange fixed, so an ending that returns through the dynamics is shown on the actual flow against a separate reference flow.

hypotheses.zh: 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。
hypotheses.en: Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

hypotheses.zh: meets_after/over/stays_met 只在所用条件与步上给平衡，m 为该式指定的固定所需；active_covered 另给实际活动、该步支持门控及实际依存。
hypotheses.en: meets_after/over/stays_met supply balance only at the used condition and steps, with m the fixed need specified in that formula; active_covered separately supplies actual activity, support-gating at that step and actual dependence.

hypotheses.zh: unfed_meets 与 fed_beyond_level 另给该段 GiversSupported；后者还给逐步需要及正取用。meets_without 给 WithheldLevels、局部平衡及所扣部分在该条件只给不取。
hypotheses.en: unfed_meets and fed_beyond_level additionally supply GiversSupported over the stretch; the latter also supplies needing and positive taking at each step. meets_without supplies WithheldLevels, local balance and no taking by the withheld part at that condition.

does_not_show.zh: 精确条件不使支持足以推出活动；需求仍满足不推出实际活动继续；见证中的活动是规定的，并与平衡、依存相容。
does_not_show.en: The exact conditions do not make support sufficient for activity; meeting needs does not imply continued actual activity; witness activity is specified and shown consistent with balance and dependence.

does_not_show.zh: 损失不总返回：Redundant 明确给出任一供给者足够与存量的界。
does_not_show.en: Loss does not always return: Redundant explicitly gives either feeder’s sufficiency and the stock bound.

does_not_show.zh: Overshoot 仍比较两个流；同一流中的扣留比较已加入，但两者都扣留而原取用固定时证明的是无平衡路径，不是给出了随之调整的活动。
does_not_show.en: Overshoot still compares two flows; withholding within one flow is added, but withholding both with the original taking fixed proves no balancing path, not a dynamically adjusted activity.

does_not_show.zh: 跨步供给只刻画可能携带，实际来源未定。
does_not_show.en: Across-step feeding characterizes possible carrying only, leaving actual origin open.

does_not_show.zh: 近乎定义：水平在每个活跃步下降，所以像排序函数一样界定运行；消耗者超出其供给者是已知的（Catton 1980）。
does_not_show.en: Near-definitional: the level falls at each active step, so it bounds the run as a ranking function does; a consumer overshooting what feeds it is known (Catton 1980).

detail.zh: 只在所需条件上表示的边界不足：Overshoot 中 true 在其所需条件上更新、保住自身支持，却经其供给者终结（Overshoot.ends_through_feeder）。
detail.en: A boundary represented over required conditions is not enough: in Overshoot true renews over the condition it requires and keeps its own support, yet ends through its feeder (Overshoot.ends_through_feeder).

detail.zh: 闭包之外的损失不必返回：Clearing 中清除者的闭包每步被支持，而栖居者终结（Clearing.closure_supported，见 feeding-closure）。
detail.en: A loss beyond the closure need not return: in Clearing the clearer's closure is supported at every step while the dweller ends (Clearing.closure_supported; see feeding-closure).

correspondence.zh: 路线 (b) 是 AI 的表述，Ren 引用了它：“No axiom. The theory only describes, and “should” is what a center does once its represented boundary matches what it actually depends on. The theory then explains recognition and motivation but claims no warrant beyond them.” Ren 选定：“let's aim for a first, then try to archive b”。作者的读法（AI 论证，依 Ren 的交托采用）：供给闭包读“what it actually depends on”。它也曾被读作 Ren 的“the system that one is in”，作为从一个中心沿依存到达的系统；这一读法已撤回：供给闭包在影响闭包之内，影响闭包与所及闭包都在系统之内，为那一层级提供的是所及闭包（见 levels-of-closure，AI 的读法，依 Ren 的交托采用）。名称（FedClosed、WithinFeeding、Overshoot 等）是 AI 按 Ren 的命名准则所选。AI 的第二种机制“constraint: a part that degrades its whole removes its own supply”在这里读作：损失经供给者返回；这一读法是 AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用。Ren 回答：“there could be the whole realizes itself(like us, we recognize that "we" are the universe/ecosystem that realizes its own existence), understanding itself, and updates itself, this is also under the selection rules and constraints in theory, but in practice, how this happens, needs more thoughts”。
correspondence.en: Route (b) is the AI's wording, which Ren quoted: “No axiom. The theory only describes, and “should” is what a center does once its represented boundary matches what it actually depends on. The theory then explains recognition and motivation but claims no warrant beyond them.” Ren chose: “let's aim for a first, then try to archive b”. The author's reading (an AI argument, adopted on Ren's delegation): the feeding closure reads “what it actually depends on”. It was also read as Ren's “the system that one is in”, the system reached from a center along dependence; that reading is withdrawn: the feeding closure lies within the influence closure, the influence and reach closures lie within the system, and the reach closure is offered for that level (see levels-of-closure; the AI's reading, adopted on Ren's delegation). The names (FedClosed, WithinFeeding, Overshoot and others) are the AI's, chosen by Ren's naming standard. The AI's second mechanism, “constraint: a part that degrades its whole removes its own supply”, is read here as a loss returning through a feeder; this reading is the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation. Ren answered: “there could be the whole realizes itself(like us, we recognize that "we" are the universe/ecosystem that realizes its own existence), understanding itself, and updates itself, this is also under the selection rules and constraints in theory, but in practice, how this happens, needs more thoughts”.

detail.zh: 复用 Flow.excess_bounded：连续 n 步联合取用多于给予时，条件的水平至少下降 n。
detail.en: Reuses Flow.excess_bounded: over n consecutive steps of joint excess, the level of the condition falls by at least n.

input.zh: 没有被支持者给予时，取用者的每个活跃步都是联合超出的一步。
input.en: Where nothing supported gives, every active step of the taker is a step of joint excess.

detail.zh: 复用供给闭包：Overshoot 中任一个的闭包都是整体，终结经闭包之内的供给者返回。
detail.en: Reuses the feeding closure: in Overshoot the closure of either is the whole, and the ending returns through a feeder within it.

detail.zh: 那里在区域上更新（Web.RenewingOver）、区域覆盖所需时保住自身支持，比较只在一步上；Overshoot 在多步上比较：在所需条件上更新、保住自身支持的形成，仍经其供给者终结。
detail.en: There renewing over a region (Web.RenewingOver) keeps one's own support where the region covers what is required, compared at one step; Overshoot compares over several steps: a formation renewing over the condition it requires and keeping its own support still ends through its feeder.

output.zh: 在区域上更新与保住自身支持。
output.en: Renewing over a region and keeping one's own support.

input.zh: 只在所需条件上表示的边界不足以保住延续。
input.en: A boundary represented over required conditions alone does not secure continuation.

conditions.zh: 平衡、只有活跃者给予与取用、活动需要支持。
conditions.en: Balance, only active formations giving and taking, activity needing support.

detail.zh: 那里 Mortal 中一个生命的取用终结共享条件的更新，后继者在它终结之后才终结；这里终结经供给者返回取用者自身。
detail.en: There, in Mortal, a life's taking ends the renewal of a shared condition and a successor ends after it has ended; here an ending returns through a feeder to the taker itself.

input.en: An ending returning to the taker.

conditions.zh: AI 的读法，依 Ren 的交托采用（DELEGATED-CHOICES D17）。
conditions.en: The AI's reading, adopted on Ren's delegation (DELEGATED-CHOICES D17).

detail.zh: 局部规律只在所用的步与条件上假定平衡，即 laws-of-one-step 的 Flow.BalancesOn（单元素家族）；全局平衡经 Flow.Balances.on 给出它，所以原定理是推论。
detail.en: The local laws assume balance only at the steps and conditions they use, Flow.BalancesOn of laws-of-one-step (singleton families); global balance gives it through Flow.Balances.on, so the original theorems are corollaries.

output.zh: 跨一步对一个有限家族的平衡（Flow.BalancesOn）；全局平衡蕴含它（Flow.Balances.on）。
output.en: Balance on a finite family across one step (Flow.BalancesOn); global balance implies it (Flow.Balances.on).

input.zh: 本记录的局部规律在所用各步对所用条件假定它。
input.en: This record's local laws assume it at the conditions and steps they use.

detail.zh: 那里每次上升都由被支持者给予，一旦什么都不被支持此后不再被支持；这里没有被支持者向所耗条件给予时，消耗至多持续该条件的水平那么多步。
detail.en: There every rise is given by a supported formation, and once nothing is supported nothing is supported again; here, where nothing supported gives to the condition consumed, consumption lasts at most as many steps as its level.

detail.zh: 形成的支持只随与其所依存者的交换，影响闭包之外的在闭包之内不显出（Flow.Balances.uncoupled_beyond_influence）；终结经供给者返回，是在影响闭包之内。
detail.en: A formation's support follows only its exchanges with what it depends on, and nothing beyond the influence closure shows within it (Flow.Balances.uncoupled_beyond_influence); an ending returning through a feeder lies within the influence closure.

history.zh: 2026-10-14 M4，按计划中为脊柱记录用短标题的建议（Ren 认可：“go with your recommendations”）：改用短标题，原标题的内容改作陈述，并压缩到陈述的长度上限（主张保留每一部分）。主张、证明与证据不变。原标题：“消耗随其供给者终结：在平衡、只有活跃者给予、活动需要支持之下，没有被支持者向一个条件给予时，从它取用的形成至多连续活跃该条件水平那么多步；供给者都不被支持时就是这样；一个在所需条件上保住自身支持的形成，仍可经其供给者终结”
history.en: 2026-10-14 M4, under the plan's recommendation of short titles for the spine records, which Ren approved (“go with your recommendations”): short title, with the former title's content now the statement, condensed to the statement's length limit (the claim keeps every part). Claim, proof and evidence unchanged. Former title: “Consumption ends with its feeders: under balance, with only active formations giving and activity needing support, where nothing supported gives to a condition, a formation taking from it is active for at most as many consecutive steps as its level; so it is where every feeder is unsupported; a formation that keeps its own support over the condition it requires can still end through its feeder”

history.zh: 2026-10-14 可读性迁移到 schema 2（开放问题计划：迁移 lint 发现最多的 schema-1 记录）：标题与陈述不变；主张拆为 11 条规律，见证 Overshoot 为规律 4–7，精确条件与 Redundant 为规律 8–11；规律 3 陈述引用与验证范围中已有的局部形式（Flow.unfed_consumption_ends_at、Flow.consumption_ends_with_feeders_at，已对照其 Lean 陈述）；限制与逐轮回执说明分入“未表明”、通用边界、对应、下一步、证据段与沿革。陈述、前提、状态、证明绑定与来源哈希均未改变。最长的一条前提去掉轮次标签并分为两条，其余文字不变。验证范围按证明绑定写明 Feeding、Continuation 与 Dependence 当前字节的绑定回执。对应中关于“the system that one is in”的较早读法及其撤回去掉了轮次标签；限制中“constraint 读法仍属 AI，待 Ren”移入对应。下一步中已完成的部分（冗余供给、储备覆盖与同一流扣留的精确界）即规律 8–11。每句旧文本的去向见迁移对照表 [consumption-ends-with-feeders.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/consumption-ends-with-feeders.md)；迁移前的完整记录为 text_versions 末项。
history.en: 14 October 2026 readability migration to schema 2 (open-issues plan: migration of the schema-1 records with the most lint findings): title and statement are kept; the claim was split into 11 laws, the witness Overshoot into laws 4–7 and the exact conditions and Redundant into laws 8–11; law 3 states the local forms that the references and the validation scope already held (Flow.unfed_consumption_ends_at, Flow.consumption_ends_with_feeders_at, read against their Lean statements); limitations and per-round receipt notes went to does-not-show items, standard boundaries, the correspondence, the next step, the evidence paragraph and history. No statement, premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. The longest hypothesis lost its round label and was split in two, its wording otherwise unchanged. The validation scope names the binding receipts of the current Feeding, Continuation and Dependence bytes from the proof bindings. In the correspondence the round labels of the earlier reading of “the system that one is in” and of its withdrawal were dropped, and the limitation that the constraint reading remains the AI's, pending Ren, moved there. The next step's completed part (exact boundaries for redundant giving, stock coverage and withholding within one flow) is laws 8–11. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [consumption-ends-with-feeders.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/consumption-ends-with-feeders.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry.
